title.en: Chapter 14 — The Beggar in the Cell

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: السيدة سانت كلير لاقتنا عالباب، ووجهها بيسأل قبل تمها.
sentences.en: Mrs. St. Clair met us at the door, her face asking before her mouth.
Holmes said: no news.
Neither good nor bad.
She said: he is alive.
Holmes said: on what evidence?
And she took out a letter.
It had arrived that day.
In her husband's hand.
With his ring in it.
It said: do not be afraid.
Everything will be put right.
There has been a great mistake, and it needs time.
Neville.

sentences.ar: وعالمغلف، ختم بريد من الشرق، من اليوم.
sentences.en: And on the envelope, a postmark from the east, from that day.

sentences.ar: هولمز فحص المكتوب طويل، تحت الضو.
sentences.en: Holmes examined the letter a long time, under the lamp.

sentences.ar: قال: العنوان كتبه واحد تاني، بحبر أسود، وحبره نشف.
sentences.en: He said: the address was written by someone else, in black ink, and the ink has dried.

sentences.ar: والرسالة كتبها زوجك، بحبر رمادي، وما نشف منيح، يعني بسرعة.
sentences.en: And the letter your husband wrote, in grey ink, and it has not dried well, so in haste.
And the ring is his, but a ring can be stolen.
She said: but the hand is his!
Holmes said: the hand is his.
And that is the best news in a week.

sentences.ar: وبالليل، بأوضة الضيوف، قعد هولمز على الأرض، على مخدات.
sentences.en: And at night, in the guest room, Holmes sat on the floor, on cushions.
Tobacco before him, the pipe in his mouth.
And I slept, and he sat.

sentences.ar: وفقت الصبح، وهو قاعد، بنفس المكان، والتبغ خلص.
sentences.en: And I woke in the morning, and he sat, in the same place, the tobacco finished.
He said: Watson, I am an ass.
I said: what?

sentences.ar: قال: بس هالمرة حمار لقى الجواب.
sentences.en: He said: but this time an ass who found the answer.
Come.

sentences.ar: وحمل حقيبة سفر زغيرة، وركبنا، وبالطريق ما حكى.
sentences.en: And he carried a small travelling bag, and we drove off, and on the way he did not speak.

sentences.ar: وصلنا مركز الشرطة الساعة سبعة الصبح، والمفتش قال: الشحاد نايم.
sentences.en: We reached the police station at seven in the morning, and the inspector said: the beggar is asleep.
Holmes said: I want to see him.

sentences.ar: قال المفتش: وسخ لدرجة إنه ما بنقدر نغسله.
sentences.en: The inspector said: so dirty we cannot wash him.
He refuses.
Holmes said: I will wash him.

sentences.ar: وفتح حقيبته، وطلع منها إسفنجة كبيرة.
sentences.en: And he opened his bag, and took from it a large sponge.

sentences.ar: الشحاد كان نايم على ظهره، وبيشخر، ووجهه للسقف.
sentences.en: The beggar lay on his back, snoring, his face to the ceiling.

sentences.ar: وجه مخيف: ندبة من عينه لشفته، والشفة مقلوبة، وشعره أحمر مشعث.
sentences.en: A frightful face: a scar from eye to lip, the lip twisted, the hair red and matted.

sentences.ar: هولمز بلل الإسفنجة بالمي، وقال: خليني أعرفكم عليه.
sentences.en: Holmes wet the sponge in the basin, and said: let me introduce you.
And wiped his face with the sponge twice, hard.
And the face came off.
The scar went.
The lip straightened.
The red hair came away with the sponge.

sentences.ar: وتحتها، رجل شاب، أبيض، ناعم الشعر، وجهه محترم.
sentences.en: And beneath, a young man, pale, with fine hair, a respectable face.

sentences.ar: وفاق، وتطلع فينا، وصرخ، وغطى وجهه بالمخدة.
sentences.en: And he woke, looked at us, cried out, and hid his face in the pillow.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: السيد نيفيل سانت كلير.
sentences.en: Holmes said: Mr. Neville St. Clair.
